reuse.why: Uses the existing small helpers (assertBankAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank, handleSyncResponse, bankSync.syncAccount, getServer) but there is no shared link/download routine in the tree and the change does not create one, so the provider flow is copied rather than reused.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near-verbatim copy of linkPluggyAiAccount (~80 lines) and downloadFintegraTransactions a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions with only the URL and log text changed.

placement.why: Linker in accounts/app.ts, downloader and dispatch in accounts/sync.ts, base URL in server-config.ts and the account type in types/models, exactly where the other providers live.

scope.why: Only the Fintegra wiring is touched; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: Follows the established per-provider pattern so it is easy to read, but adds a sixth copy of the link flow and a fourth copy of the download function, and carries a Pluggy-specific fileId argument into syncAccount for no stated reason.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Calls the existing helpers; no shared abstraction for linking or downloading exists to be bypassed.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies in app.ts (linkFintegraAccount) and sync.ts (downloadFintegraTransactions) are open, not renamed or reshaped.
